title: Petrov-Galerkin operator inference with application to stability-encouraging identification
summary: Data-driven model order reduction methods such as operator inference enable the efficient construction of reduced-order models directly from high-dimensional time-domain data. Standard operator inference typically seeks a Galerkin-type reduced model in a prescribed low-dimensional subspace by identifying its reduced operators from projected snapshot data. The resulting inference problem is formulated as a least-squares problem admitting an efficient closed-form solution.
